Website information

Your enquiry.
Your choice.

A straightforward explanation of how the website’s quote planner works.

Quote planner

The planner creates a message in your browser. It does not submit your details to a website database and does not save them in browser storage. When you choose “Open email app”, the message is passed to your email software. You decide whether to send it to NN Paving. “Copy message” places the prepared text on your device clipboard.

Contact details

For questions about an enquiry or your information, contact NN Paving at NNPaving@gmail.com or 07999 749569. Do not include sensitive personal information in an initial project enquiry.

External services

Facebook links open Facebook, which operates under its own privacy policies. Fonts may be loaded from Google Fonts, which receives the network information needed to deliver them. No advertising or analytics scripts are included in the site code. The page may keep temporary interaction markers in memory for this visit, such as a quote or phone link being opened; they are cleared on reload and are not sent to NN Paving or any analytics service. The hosting service may process technical logs and, for private access, sign-in information.

Business information

Contact information, the service range and photographs were sourced from NN Paving’s Facebook page. Its recommendation summary was checked on 30 September 2026. No awards, accreditations, company registration number, insurance details, fixed guarantees or finance offers have been added without verification.
